instruction: Locate the travel advisory and policies page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Navigate from United Airlines homepage to travel advisory and policies page. Uses same URL pattern matching evaluator. Similar difficulty to original task (single navigation goal within same website).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL using active_tab_info function
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match appropriately uses regex pattern matching to verify the URL
Expected URL pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/notices' correctly identifies the target travel advisory and policies page
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with 'url' field, metric accepts dict and extracts URL properly
Evaluator covers the complete instruction requirement: checking if user navigated to the correct page
Pattern matching using re.search() allows flexible matching with query parameters and trailing paths, which is appropriate for URL verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The expected pattern string contains special regex characters (dots and slashes) that should ideally be escaped for strict regex correctness, though in practice this works fine since '.' matches any character (including literal dots) and '/' is not a special character in Python regex
